text: Policy HR-204: Employees are entitled to 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Unused leave up to 5 days can be carried forward.
Policy HR-310: Remote work requires written approval from the line manager. Employees may work from home up to 2 days a week.
Policy IT-501: Laptops must be encrypted and passwords changed every 90 days. Report lost devices to the IT helpdesk within 24 hours.
Policy FIN-112: Travel expenses above 5000 INR require pre-approval. Submit receipts within 15 days of the trip.
Code of Conduct CC-007: Harassment of any kind is prohibited. Complaints are handled by the Ethics Committee led by Ms. Priya Nair.
Maternity benefit MB-90: Female employees get 26 weeks of paid maternity leave. Paternity leave is 10 days.
Sick leave: Employees can take 12 days of sick leave per year. A medical certificate is needed for absences longer than 2 days.
Payroll: Salaries are credited on the last working day of each month. Payslips are available on the employee portal.
Onboarding: New hires receive a laptop, ID card and access badge on day one. Orientation is conducted by Mr. Rahul Verma, Head of Talent.
Security SEC-880: Visitors must sign in at reception and wear a visitor badge at all times inside the office.
Performance review: Appraisals happen twice a year, in June and December. Ratings influence bonus and promotion decisions.
Learning budget LD-45: Each employee can claim up to 20000 INR per year for approved courses and certifications.
Policy HR-201: Employees must complete mandatory safety training within 30 days of joining.
Policy HR-202: Employees must submit timesheets every Friday through the HR portal.
Policy HR-203: Employees must update their emergency contact details every year.
Policy HR-205: Employees must complete the data privacy course within 60 days of joining.
Policy HR-206: Employees must acknowledge the code of conduct every January.
Policy FIN-111: Client entertainment expenses above 3000 INR require pre-approval. Submit receipts within 10 days.
Policy FIN-113: Mobile bills above 1500 INR require pre-approval. Submit bills within 20 days.
Policy FIN-121: Training expenses above 8000 INR require pre-approval. Submit invoices within 30 days.
Security SEC-881: Contractors must sign in at reception and wear a contractor badge at all times inside the office.
Security SEC-870: Delivery staff must sign in at the gate and wear a delivery pass at all times inside the campus.
Security SEC-808: Vendors must sign in at the front desk and wear a vendor tag at all times inside the building.
Learning budget LD-44: Each employee can claim up to 15000 INR per year for approved books and workshops.
Learning budget LD-46: Each employee can claim up to 25000 INR per year for approved conferences and seminars.
Learning budget LD-54: Each manager can claim up to 30000 INR per year for approved leadership programs.
Code of Conduct CC-008: Conflicts of interest are reviewed by the Audit Committee led by Ms. Priya Nayak.
Facilities FC-021: Cafeteria and parking issues are handled by Ms. Preeti Nair, Head of Facilities.
